verdict.rationale: Parsec's downloads page lists clients for Windows, macOS, Linux (Ubuntu 22.04), Android and a Chrome web client, and hosting is offered on both Windows 10+ and macOS 10.15+. Because Linux, Android and web can only be viewers, connecting from a different OS than the host is clearly implied, though never stated outright. missing for 10: iOS/iPadOS client, explicit documentation of cross-OS host/viewer pairings, Linux hosting, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform use.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems
